designation: new versioned study; all original R20 tasks/cases already exposed
primary_question: Under one public scope, typed IR and executor, does evidence-bound construction reduce false passes while retaining valid cases compared with direct construction?
common_controls: one attempt, no repair or retry
same core scope admission and executor

development.old_cases: diagnostic/development use only; recompute under explicit new observation policy

smoke.designation: infrastructure diagnostic, excluded from development/confirmation counts

selection.utility: task-macro valid retention minus false-pass rate, averaged equally across models
selection.joint_gain_target: both models have nonnegative retention difference and nonpositive false-pass difference relative to direct, with at least one strict improvement
selection.reject_blanket_solution: all-unknown safety cannot satisfy retained-valid improvement

secondary_admission: scope_source, crossed with every construction arm; literal request quote and structural source paths are checked, semantic necessity is not certified

analysis.risk_and_retention_denominator: supported primary tasks, per-task equal weight
analysis.confidence_intervals: paired task bootstrap, 10000 resamples, fixed seed 20261004
analysis.primary_contrast: evidence_bound vs direct for each model under scope admission; joint safety/retention, no pooling of composite or development

authority_limits: source-defined selected partial obligations, not full benchmark utility
no model or programmatic reference is a semantic oracle
new observation policy is versioned, not retroactive R20 label replacement
recognized complete answer absence differs from unavailable observation
new confirmations use new case realizations on exposed tasks
